Jobrown Global Venture

Brand Strategy, Identity & Business Materials · Oil & Gas Services
Timeline
2025
Engagement
Brand-launch project
Deliverables
8 deliverable types

Jobrown Global Venture is a new oil-and-gas-services business.

The Problem

A new business needed a credible, complete brand launch foundation for formal B2B contexts.

The Strategic Move

Use a flame-and-droplet symbol built from nested chevrons. The droplet suggests resource, flow, technical handling, and operational discipline. The flame suggests energy, output, ambition, and forward movement. Nested chevrons create a controlled, engineered rather than generic visual character, and the colour progression from red through orange and amber to gold suggests energy moving toward value and refined output.

What We Built
  • Brand strategy
  • Naming and tagline direction
  • Logo and visual identity
  • Colour and typography system
  • Letterhead
  • Business card
  • Envelope
  • Single service flyer
Outcome

A completed brand-launch system that provides a coherent, professional foundation for introducing the business and communicating its services.

An earlier lockup direction, tried with a different tagline before the client settled on the current name treatment and 'powering tomorrow' line.

The Mark

A layered flame-and-droplet icon built from nested chevrons, moving from red at the outer ring to gold at the core, a nod to both the energy sector and refined output.

Stationery

Letterhead, business-card back, and a dark-mode service flyer, all keeping the same red-to-gold gradient and the same short, punchy services list front and centre.

Applied

The full stationery set styled together: letterhead, business card, branded pen, envelope, and the flyer on screen.
